The BA (Bachelor of Arts) programme provides detailed knowledge and skills in the fields of Humanities, Social Sciences, Languages, Literature, Fine Arts, Psychology, Political Science, History, Economics, Sociology, Geography, and other domains.
The BA programme prepares students for careers in both public and private sectors while developing analytical thinking, communication, research, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
Several universities offer a 4-year BA (Honours/Research) programme with additional research opportunities and multidisciplinary learning.
Students may pursue the course in different modes such as full-time, part-time, online, distance, or integrated, depending on their career goals and flexibility.
